card.name: Words just before "processed/processing"
card.fires_on: Words in web text where the next word is likely "processed", "processing" or "processor", such as "This page was" or "The data". Weaker, scattered hits appear partway through other words.

modes.label: Right before processed
modes.description: A passive verb or noun after which "processed" or "processing" is expected, in page footers or computing text.

modes.description: Words in technical text where a processing term would follow, such as data or a secondary processor.

modes.label: Scattered word starts
modes.description: Weak hits partway through unrelated words, with no shared theme.
modes.example: Memorial Day<< par>>ades, many have not held a parade
